services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery & Care Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From emergency storm damage to routine pruning and stump removal, we handle every aspect of tree care with safety and precision.

services.title: Emergency Tree Removal
services.desc: Dangerous or storm-damaged trees taken down safely, often on the same day. We manage all debris removal and site clearance.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Trim back overgrown branches that block light, hang over your roof, or threaten power lines. Improves tree health and your garden views.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Fast, mechanical stump grinding leaves your garden level and ready to replant. We handle all ground-level clearance.

services.title: Tree Felling
services.desc: Large tree removal carried out with precision rigging and sectional dismantling. Fully insured and safe for neighbouring properties.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming keeps boundaries neat and healthy. We work to your preferred height and thickness year-round.

services.title: Arboricultural Advice
services.desc: Free on-site assessment of problem trees, disease diagnosis, and recommendations to save valuable specimens or plan safe removal.

about_pullquote: A tree that's safe is a tree you can enjoy for life.
about_para_1: Valley Tree Care was founded 18 years ago by Paul Matthews, a fully qualified NPTC-certified arborist frustrated by shortcuts and overpricing in the tree surgery trade. What started as a one-man operation in Bishop's Waltham has grown to a trusted team serving homeowners and businesses across Southampton and the wider South Coast. We've felled and pruned over 1,200 trees whilst maintaining the highest safety and environmental standards.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, doing what we quoted, and leaving your garden cleaner than we found it. We recycle every branch and log responsibly, and we never disappear mid-job. Customers come back because they trust us — and because they know their trees are in the hands of people who actually care about them.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Valley Tree Care

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was dying and dropping branches everywhere. Paul came out, gave us a straight quote, and removed it without any fuss. The whole garden was clean again by end of day. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Our hedge had got completely out of hand after lockdown. Valley Tree Care trimmed it back beautifully and it's already growing back thick and healthy. Really reasonable price too. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11pm because a branch came down in the storm. Paul was here by 7am next morning and had it all cleared before we'd even finished breakfast. Can't ask for better than that.
reviews.author: Robert T.
